Task Guide:


Task: Bulk Modulus of Copper
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of copper by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for copper. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: metal
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-30
- atom_style: atomic
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

IMPORTANT: You have access to filesystem tools. All files will be saved in your isolated workspace.
 Save all the files in /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/copper_bulk_modulus_trial_2 when using tools use this path.


You must think what to do next. You can use some of the tools available in the system.

When you think that the task is completed, you can submit the answer.
For that, answer with: "Final Answer: <your answer>". It is very important to follow this format.

1. First, let's get the copper structure from Materials Project (mp-30)
2. Convert it to LAMMPS format
3. Create and run the LAMMPS simulation to calculate elastic constants
4. Process the results to get the bulk modulus

function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/copper_bulk_modulus_trial_2/in.elastic", "content": "# Elastic constant calculation for FCC copper

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Cu.data

# EAM potential for Cu
pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Cu_u3.eam

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Define deformation size
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Output settings
thermo_style custom step temp pe press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz lx ly lz vol
thermo 100

# Elastic constants calculation
variable d1 equal ${up}
variable d2 equal ${down}

# Initial state
variable tmp equal pxx
variable p1 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pyy
variable p2 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pzz
variable p3 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pxy
variable p4 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pxz
variable p5 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pyz
variable p6 equal ${tmp}

# Deformation 1 - xx
fix 1 all deform 1 x scale 1.0001
run 0
variable C11 equal -(v_p1-${p1})/v_d1
unfix 1

# Deformation 2 - yy
fix 2 all deform 1 y scale 1.0001
run 0
variable C22 equal -(v_p2-${p2})/v_d1
unfix 2

# Deformation 3 - zz
fix 3 all deform 1 z scale 1.0001
run 0
variable C33 equal -(v_p3-${p3})/v_d1
unfix 3

# Deformation 4 - yz
fix 4 all deform 1 yz 0.0001
run 0
variable C44 equal -(v_p6-${p6})/v_d1
unfix 4

# Deformation 5 - xz
fix 5 all deform 1 xz 0.0001
run 0
variable C55 equal -(v_p5-${p5})/v_d1
unfix 5

# Deformation 6 - xy
fix 6 all deform 1 xy 0.0001
run 0
variable C66 equal -(v_p4-${p4})/v_d1
unfix 6

# Output elastic constants
print "C11 = ${C11}"
print "C22 = ${C22}"
print "C33 = ${C33}"
print "C44 = ${C44}"
print "C55 = ${C55}"
print "C66 = ${C66}"

# Calculate bulk modulus (Voigt average)
variable B equal (${C11}+${C22}+${C33})/3.0
print "Bulk Modulus = ${B} GPa""}
